description: Election Commission - K. D. A. jayanthi was Selected as the member of the Kanthale Pradeshiya Sabha
categorisation: This gazette content specifically addresses the filling of a vacancy in a local government body (Kanthale Pradeshiya Sabha) under the Local Authorities Elections Ordinance. It involves electoral processes including the declaration of a selected member to fill a vacancy caused by death, which falls under election-related matters. The content references specific sections of election ordinances and involves the Returning Officer's official declaration, making it clearly related to electoral processes rather than general government personnel changes or other categories.
